question: Unsa ang proseso para sa bag-ong negosyo kung walay daang valid nga FSIC gikan sa pagkuha ug occupancy permit?
answer:
Sa pag-apply sa bag-ong negosyo kung walay daang valid nga FSIC gikan sa pagkuha ug occupancy permit, mao ang proseso:

1. Pag-apply sa New Business Permit Without Valid FSIC Issued During Occupancy Permit Stage [S1]
2. Submit documents, na kini mao ang mga nakit-an:
   - Design plans, calculations, and specifications signed and sealed by the Professional Engineer/Architect [S2]
   - As-built plan together with the building permit (If there is changes/modifications) [S2]
   - Business ID number (If pending, comply with requirements. If denied, proceed to ROs denying the application for further information) [S3]
   - Affidavit of Undertaking that there had been no substantial changes made on the building) [S3]
   - Issue Notice to Proceed for the approval by the Regulatory Offices. [S3]

Wala pa kini ang impormasyon kung saan mao ang mga lugar na mao nga mag-issue ang FSIC. (Wala akoy nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin niini sa Citizens' Charter)

ground_truth: If a new business permit applicant has no valid FSIC from the occupancy stage, they must submit the Unified Application Form (BOSS) and tax assessment bill, pay the 15% FSIF, and undergo a joint ocular inspection by the BFP.
